Loading packages 

```{r}
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(mgcv)
library(spdep)
library(PRROC)

# Folder containing the three crime-stage GeoPackages
OBJECTIVE3_DIR <- "C:/Users/eldayit/OneDrive - University of Maryland/Desktop/All files/Ventures/Pangolins_Gabon/Input/Objective_3"

INPUT_DIR <- dirname(OBJECTIVE3_DIR)

# Crime-stage files
stage_files <- c(
  Stage_I   = file.path(OBJECTIVE3_DIR, "Crime_stage_I.gpkg"),
  Stage_II  = file.path(OBJECTIVE3_DIR, "Crime_stage_II.gpkg"),
  Stage_III = file.path(OBJECTIVE3_DIR, "Crime_stage_III.gpkg")
)

# The exact nine covariates used in the previous analysis
covariate_names <- c(
  "B_distance_to_Forest_Concessions",
  "B_distance_to_InternationalGabonBorders",
  "B_distance_to_MajorGabonCities",
  "B_distance_to_majorRoads",
  "B_distance_to_ProtectedAreas",
  "B_distance_to_waterways",
  "B_LAI_2024",
  "B_Population_2020",
  "B_SRTM_2000"
)

# Spatial cross-validation settings
N_FOLDS <- 5
BLOCK_SIZE_M <- 80000 #[m]
SPATIAL_K <- 20 # Maximum allowed complexity (basis dimension) of the 2-D spatial smooth s(x, y)

stopifnot(all(file.exists(stage_files)))

# Knitting runs in a fresh R session, so load the stage data here.
crime_points <- lapply(stage_files, function(f) st_read(f, quiet = TRUE))

# Use the first stage's CRS consistently for the initial vector maps.
if (is.na(st_crs(crime_points[[1]]))) {
  stop("The Stage I point data have no CRS. Define their CRS before proceeding.")
}
crime_points <- lapply(crime_points, function(x) {
  if (is.na(st_crs(x))) stop("A crime-stage dataset has no CRS.")
  st_transform(x, st_crs(crime_points[[1]]))
})
```

2. Loading and visualizing the 9 covariates

```{r}
# Search both Input and Objective_3 recursively for GeoTIFF files.
search_folders <- unique(c(INPUT_DIR, OBJECTIVE3_DIR))

all_raster_files <- unlist(
  lapply(search_folders, function(folder) {
    list.files(
      folder,
      pattern = "\\.(tif|tiff)$",
      full.names = TRUE,
      recursive = TRUE,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  })
)

all_raster_files <- unique(all_raster_files)

if (length(all_raster_files) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No .tif or .tiff files were found under:\n",
    paste(search_folders, collapse = "\n")
  )
}

# Remove file extension and match each expected covariate name.
raster_base_names <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(all_raster_files))

cov_files <- sapply(covariate_names, function(covariate) {

  matching_file <- all_raster_files[
    tolower(raster_base_names) == tolower(covariate)
  ]

  if (length(matching_file) == 0) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  matching_file[1]
})

names(cov_files) <- covariate_names

# Stop and tell you exactly which covariate file was not located.
if (any(is.na(cov_files))) {
  missing_covariates <- names(cov_files)[is.na(cov_files)]

  cat("These raster files were found:\n")
  print(all_raster_files)

  stop(
    "\nCould not find these expected covariate rasters:\n",
    paste(missing_covariates, collapse = "\n"),
    "\n\nCheck whether their filenames differ from the names in covariate_names."
  )
}

# Print the exact files used.
cat("The following nine covariate rasters will be used:\n")
print(cov_files)

# Verify each input grid before stacking.
cov_layers <- lapply(unname(cov_files), terra::rast)
alignment_ok <- vapply(cov_layers, function(layer) {
  terra::compareGeom(cov_layers[[1]], layer, stopOnError = FALSE)
}, logical(1))
if (!all(alignment_ok)) {
  stop("Covariate grids are not aligned: ",
       paste(covariate_names[!alignment_ok], collapse = ", "))
}
cat("All nine covariate grids are aligned.\n")

# Load rasters in the intended covariate order.
covs <- rast(cov_layers)
names(covs) <- covariate_names

# Reproject points to the covariate grid before rasterization.
crime_points <- lapply(crime_points, function(x) st_transform(x, crs(covs)))

print(covs)

# Map all nine covariates.
par(mfrow = c(3, 3), mar = c(2, 2, 3, 4))

for (j in seq_len(nlyr(covs))) {
  plot(covs[[j]], main = names(covs)[j])
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

3. Check CRS, grid alignment, extent, resolution, and covariate correlation

```{r}
# 2. Spearman correlation: calculate without printing the full matrix
cov_values <- as.data.frame(covs, na.rm = TRUE)

cor_matrix <- cor(
  cov_values,
  method = "spearman",
  use = "complete.obs"
)

# 3. Keep each covariate pair once; remove diagonal self-correlations
cor_pairs <- as.data.frame(as.table(cor_matrix), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    variable_1 = Var1,
    variable_2 = Var2,
    spearman_rho = Freq
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    abs_rho = abs(spearman_rho),
    keep_pair = match(variable_1, colnames(cor_matrix)) <
      match(variable_2, colnames(cor_matrix))
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(keep_pair) |>
  dplyr::select(-keep_pair)

# Most negative, most positive, and strongest absolute correlation
min_pair <- cor_pairs |>
  dplyr::slice_min(spearman_rho, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)

max_pair <- cor_pairs |>
  dplyr::slice_max(spearman_rho, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)

strongest_pair <- cor_pairs |>
  dplyr::slice_max(abs_rho, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)

cat("\n================ SPEARMAN CORRELATION SUMMARY ================\n")

cat(
  "\nMinimum correlation:\n  rho = ", round(min_pair$spearman_rho, 3),
  "\n  Variables: ", min_pair$variable_1,
  " and ", min_pair$variable_2, "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "\nMaximum correlation:\n  rho = ", round(max_pair$spearman_rho, 3),
  "\n  Variables: ", max_pair$variable_1,
  " and ", max_pair$variable_2, "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "\nLargest absolute correlation used for collinearity screening:\n  |rho| = ",
  round(strongest_pair$abs_rho, 3),
  "\n  Variables: ", strongest_pair$variable_1,
  " and ", strongest_pair$variable_2, "\n",
  sep = ""
)

if (strongest_pair$abs_rho < 0.70) {
  cat("\nNo pair exceeded |rho| = 0.70; all covariates are retained.\n")
} else {
  cat("\nAt least one pair reached |rho| = 0.70; review correlated covariates.\n")
}
```

4. Convert points to binary occurrence maps on the covariate grid

```{r}
template_raster <- covs[[1]]

# Keep only cells where every covariate has a non-missing value.
valid_mask <- app(covs, fun = function(x) as.integer(all(!is.na(x))))

stage_counts <- list()
stage_occurrence <- list()

for (stage_name in names(crime_points)) {

  pts <- crime_points[[stage_name]]
  pts$one_point <- 1

  # Count points in each covariate-grid cell.
  count_raster <- rasterize(
    vect(pts),
    template_raster,
    field = "one_point",
    fun = "sum",
    background = 0
  )

  # Convert counts to binary occurrence: 0 = no point, 1 = >= 1 point.
  occurrence_raster <- ifel(count_raster > 0, 1, 0)

  # Remove cells lacking any covariate value.
  count_raster <- mask(count_raster, valid_mask, maskvalues = 0)
  occurrence_raster <- mask(occurrence_raster, valid_mask, maskvalues = 0)

  names(count_raster) <- paste0(stage_name, "_count")
  names(occurrence_raster) <- paste0(stage_name, "_occurrence")

  stage_counts[[stage_name]] <- count_raster
  stage_occurrence[[stage_name]] <- occurrence_raster

  # Console summary
  n_valid_cells <- global(!is.na(occurrence_raster), "sum", na.rm = TRUE)[1, 1]
  n_positive_cells <- global(occurrence_raster, "sum", na.rm = TRUE)[1, 1]

  cat("\n", stage_name, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Total participatory-mapped points:", nrow(pts), "\n")
  cat("Positive covariate-grid cells:", n_positive_cells, "\n")
  cat("Valid covariate-grid cells:", n_valid_cells, "\n")
  cat("Percentage of cells containing >=1 mapped point:",
      round(100 * n_positive_cells / n_valid_cells, 3), "%\n")
}

# Map the binary occurrence rasters
par(mfrow = c(1, 3), mar = c(2, 2, 3, 2))

for (stage_name in names(stage_occurrence)) {
  plot(
    stage_occurrence[[stage_name]],
    col = c("grey95", "#d73027"),
    breaks = c(-0.5, 0.5, 1.5),
    legend = FALSE,
    main = paste(gsub("_", " ", stage_name), "occurrence")
  )
  legend(
    "bottomleft",
    legend = c("No mapped point", ">=1 mapped point"),
    fill = c("grey95", "#d73027"),
    bty = "n"
  )
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# Folder for exported maps
OUTPUT_DIR <- "C:/Users/eldayit/OneDrive - University of Maryland/Desktop/All files/Ventures/Pangolins_Gabon/Output/Maps"

# Create the folder if it does not already exist
if (!dir.exists(OUTPUT_DIR)) {
  dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE)
}
```

5. Standardize covariates, create spatial folds, and perform spatial cross-validation

```{r}
# Standardize covariates using all valid Gabon grid cells.
cov_means <- sapply(cov_values, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
cov_sds <- sapply(cov_values, sd, na.rm = TRUE)

covs_z <- covs

for (j in seq_len(nlyr(covs))) {
  covs_z[[j]] <- (covs[[j]] - cov_means[j]) / cov_sds[j]
}

names(covs_z) <- paste0("z_", names(covs))

# Create one modelling table containing coordinates, standardized covariates,
# and the three binary occurrence outcomes.
model_rasters <- c(covs_z, rast(stage_occurrence))

model_df <- as.data.frame(
  model_rasters,
  xy = TRUE,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Make regular preliminary spatial blocks, then group them into five
# broad, geographically compact cross-validation folds.
model_df$block_x <- floor((model_df$x - min(model_df$x)) / BLOCK_SIZE_M)
model_df$block_y <- floor((model_df$y - min(model_df$y)) / BLOCK_SIZE_M)
model_df$small_block <- interaction(model_df$block_x, model_df$block_y, drop = TRUE)

outcome_names <- names(stage_occurrence)
z_covariate_names <- names(covs_z)

block_summary <- model_df |>
  dplyr::group_by(small_block) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    x = mean(x),
    y = mean(y),
    dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(outcome_names), sum),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Try several seeds and retain the geographically compact fold arrangement
# with the best distribution of positive cells across folds.
best_solution <- NULL
best_minimum <- -Inf

for (seed in 1:100) {
  set.seed(seed)

  km <- kmeans(
    scale(block_summary[, c("x", "y")]),
    centers = N_FOLDS,
    nstart = 20
  )

  candidate <- block_summary
  candidate$fold <- km$cluster

  positive_by_fold <- candidate |>
    dplyr::group_by(fold) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(outcome_names), sum),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  smallest_positive_count <- min(as.matrix(positive_by_fold[, outcome_names]))

  if (smallest_positive_count > best_minimum) {
    best_minimum <- smallest_positive_count
    best_solution <- candidate
  }
}

model_df <- model_df |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    best_solution[, c("small_block", "fold")],
    by = "small_block"
  )

cat("Number of preliminary", BLOCK_SIZE_M / 1000, "km spatial blocks:",
    nrow(block_summary), "\n")
cat("Number of broad spatial cross-validation folds:", N_FOLDS, "\n\n")

fold_prevalence <- model_df |>
  dplyr::group_by(fold) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_cells = dplyr::n(),
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(outcome_names),
      list(n_positive = ~ sum(.x), prevalence = ~ mean(.x))
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(fold_prevalence, n = Inf)

# Formula: occurrence ~ nine standardized covariates + broad 2-D spatial surface
gam_formula <- as.formula(
  paste(
    "OUTCOME ~",
    paste(z_covariate_names, collapse = " + "),
    "+ s(x, y, k =", SPATIAL_K, ", bs = 'tp')"
  )
)

# Function for PR-AUC
calculate_pr_auc <- function(observed, predicted) {
  PRROC::pr.curve(
    scores.class0 = predicted[observed == 1],
    scores.class1 = predicted[observed == 0],
    curve = FALSE
  )$auc.integral
}

# Fit spatial binomial GAMs using held-out spatial folds.
oof_predictions <- list()
fold_metrics <- list()

for (outcome_name in outcome_names) {

  cat("\nRunning spatial cross-validation for", outcome_name, "\n")

  stage_oof <- list()
  stage_metrics <- list()

  for (held_out_fold in sort(unique(model_df$fold))) {

    cat("  Held-out fold", held_out_fold, "of", N_FOLDS, "\n")

    train_df <- model_df |>
      dplyr::filter(fold != held_out_fold)

    test_df <- model_df |>
      dplyr::filter(fold == held_out_fold)

    fold_formula <- update(
      gam_formula,
      paste(outcome_name, "~ .")
    )

    fold_model <- bam(
      formula = fold_formula,
      family = binomial(link = "logit"),
      data = train_df,
      method = "fREML",
      discrete = TRUE
    )

    test_df$predicted_probability <- as.numeric(
      predict(fold_model, newdata = test_df, type = "response")
    )

    observed <- test_df[[outcome_name]]
    predicted <- test_df$predicted_probability
    prevalence <- mean(observed)

    stage_metrics[[as.character(held_out_fold)]] <- data.frame(
      stage = outcome_name,
      fold = held_out_fold,
      n_cells = nrow(test_df),
      n_positive = sum(observed),
      prevalence = prevalence,
      PR_AUC = calculate_pr_auc(observed, predicted),
      Brier_score = mean((observed - predicted)^2),
      Brier_prevalence_baseline = mean((observed - prevalence)^2)
    )

    stage_oof[[as.character(held_out_fold)]] <- test_df |>
      dplyr::select(
        x, y, fold,
        observed = dplyr::all_of(outcome_name),
        predicted_probability
      )
  }

  stage_oof <- dplyr::bind_rows(stage_oof)
  stage_oof$stage <- outcome_name

  oof_predictions[[outcome_name]] <- stage_oof
  fold_metrics[[outcome_name]] <- dplyr::bind_rows(stage_metrics)
}

oof_predictions <- dplyr::bind_rows(oof_predictions)
fold_metrics <- dplyr::bind_rows(fold_metrics)

cat("\nFold-specific spatial cross-validation metrics:\n")
print(fold_metrics, row.names = FALSE)

# Overall OOF metrics: all held-out predictions combined across folds.
overall_metrics <- oof_predictions |>
  dplyr::group_by(stage) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_cells = dplyr::n(),
    positive_cell_prevalence = mean(observed),
    PR_AUC = calculate_pr_auc(observed, predicted_probability),
    Brier_score = mean((observed - predicted_probability)^2),
    Brier_prevalence_baseline = mean((observed - mean(observed))^2),
    Brier_skill_vs_prevalence =
      1 - Brier_score / Brier_prevalence_baseline,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\nOverall spatial out-of-fold metrics:\n")
print(overall_metrics, n = Inf)

# Moran's I of out-of-fold residuals.
# Eight nearest neighbouring cells define spatial neighbours.
morans_results <- list()

for (stage_name in unique(oof_predictions$stage)) {

  this_stage <- oof_predictions |>
    dplyr::filter(stage == stage_name)

  residuals_oof <- this_stage$observed - this_stage$predicted_probability
  coordinates_oof <- as.matrix(this_stage[, c("x", "y")])

  neighbours <- knn2nb(knearneigh(coordinates_oof, k = 8))
  spatial_weights <- nb2listw(neighbours, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

  morans_results[[stage_name]] <- moran.test(
    residuals_oof,
    spatial_weights,
    zero.policy = TRUE
  )

  cat("\nOut-of-fold residual Moran's I for", stage_name, ":\n")
  print(morans_results[[stage_name]])
}
```

6. Refit final models using all Gabon cells, map final probabilities, and print coefficients

```{r}
final_models <- list()
final_probability_maps <- list()
coefficient_tables <- list()

for (outcome_name in outcome_names) {

  cat("\nFitting final all-Gabon model for", outcome_name, "\n")

  final_formula <- update(
    gam_formula,
    paste(outcome_name, "~ .")
  )

  final_model <- bam(
    formula = final_formula,
    family = binomial(link = "logit"),
    data = model_df,
    method = "fREML",
    discrete = TRUE
  )

  final_models[[outcome_name]] <- final_model

  # Final predicted probability for every valid covariate-grid cell.
  model_df$final_probability <- as.numeric(
    predict(final_model, newdata = model_df, type = "response")
  )

  probability_raster <- template_raster
  values(probability_raster) <- NA_real_

  cell_numbers <- cellFromXY(
    probability_raster,
    model_df[, c("x", "y")]
  )

  values(probability_raster)[cell_numbers] <- model_df$final_probability
  names(probability_raster) <- paste0(outcome_name, "_occurrence_probability")

  final_probability_maps[[outcome_name]] <- probability_raster

  # Parametric covariate coefficients and odds ratios.
  coefficient_table <- as.data.frame(summary(final_model)$p.table)
  coefficient_table$term <- rownames(coefficient_table)
  rownames(coefficient_table) <- NULL

  coefficient_table <- coefficient_table |>
    dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      odds_ratio = exp(Estimate),
      stage = outcome_name
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(stage, term, Estimate, `Std. Error`, `z value`,
                  `Pr(>|z|)`, odds_ratio)

  coefficient_tables[[outcome_name]] <- coefficient_table

  cat("\nStandardized covariate coefficients for", outcome_name, ":\n")
  print(coefficient_table, row.names = FALSE)

  cat("\nFull GAM summary, including the spatial smooth:\n")
  print(summary(final_model))
}

coefficient_tables <- dplyr::bind_rows(coefficient_tables)

# Map final occurrence probabilities.
par(mfrow = c(1, 3), mar = c(2, 2, 3, 4))

for (stage_name in names(final_probability_maps)) {
  plot(
    final_probability_maps[[stage_name]],
    main = paste(gsub("_", " ", stage_name), "predicted occurrence probability")
  )
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
# Folder for exported maps
OUTPUT_DIR <- "C:/Users/eldayit/OneDrive - University of Maryland/Desktop/All files/Ventures/Pangolins_Gabon/Output/Maps"

if (!dir.exists(OUTPUT_DIR)) {
  dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE)
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Prepare coefficients and approximate 95% confidence intervals
plot_data <- coefficient_tables |>
  mutate(
    covariate = case_when(
      term == "z_B_distance_to_Forest_Concessions" ~
        "Distance to forest concessions",
      term == "z_B_distance_to_InternationalGabonBorders" ~
        "Distance to international borders",
      term == "z_B_distance_to_MajorGabonCities" ~
        "Distance to major cities",
      term == "z_B_distance_to_majorRoads" ~
        "Distance to major roads",
      term == "z_B_distance_to_ProtectedAreas" ~
        "Distance to protected areas",
      term == "z_B_distance_to_waterways" ~
        "Distance to waterways",
      term == "z_B_LAI_2024" ~
        "Leaf area index",
      term == "z_B_Population_2020" ~
        "Population density",
      term == "z_B_SRTM_2000" ~
        "Elevation",
      TRUE ~ term
    ),

    stage = factor(
      stage,
      levels = c("Stage_I", "Stage_II", "Stage_III"),
      labels = c("Stage I", "Stage II", "Stage III")
    ),

    # Approximate 95% Wald confidence intervals
    lower_ci = Estimate - 1.96 * `Std. Error`,
    upper_ci = Estimate + 1.96 * `Std. Error`
  )

# Order covariates by their largest |coefficient| across the three stages
covariate_order <- plot_data |>
  group_by(covariate) |>
  summarise(
    max_abs_coefficient = max(abs(Estimate), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(max_abs_coefficient) |>
  pull(covariate)

plot_data <- plot_data |>
  mutate(
    covariate = factor(covariate, levels = covariate_order)
  )

# Colours for the three crime stages
stage_colours <- c(
  "Stage I"   = "#1b9e77",
  "Stage II"  = "#d95f02",
  "Stage III" = "#7570b3"
)

# Slightly separate the three estimates within each covariate row
stage_dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.6, reverse = TRUE)

coefficient_plot <- ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(x = Estimate, y = covariate, colour = stage)
) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey50"
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = lower_ci, xmax = upper_ci),
    orientation = "y",
    position = stage_dodge,
    width = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_point(
    position = stage_dodge,
    size = 2.8
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = stage_colours,
    name = "Crime stage"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = expression("Standardized coefficient (" * beta * ")"),
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, colour = "black"),
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
  axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", colour = "black"),

  legend.position = "top",
  legend.justification = "right",
  legend.direction = "horizontal",
  legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "grey70"),
  legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "black"),
  legend.text = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "black"),

  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )

# Display the plot
print(coefficient_plot)

# Folder for the exported figure
OUTPUT_DIR <- "C:/Users/eldayit/OneDrive - University of Maryland/Desktop/All files/Ventures/Pangolins_Gabon/Output/Maps"

if (!dir.exists(OUTPUT_DIR)) {
  dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE)
}

figure_file <- file.path(
  OUTPUT_DIR,
  "GAM_standardized_coefficients_colour_by_stage.png"
)

if (file.exists(figure_file)) {
  suffix <- 1L
  repeat {
    candidate_file <- file.path(
      OUTPUT_DIR,
      paste0("GAM_standardized_coefficients_colour_by_stage_", suffix, ".png")
    )
    if (!file.exists(candidate_file)) break
    suffix <- suffix + 1L
  }
  figure_file <- candidate_file
}

ggsave(
  filename = figure_file,
  plot = coefficient_plot,
  width = 11,
  height = 7,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

cat("Figure saved to:", figure_file, "\n")
```
